description: Rebuild your resident's own house, one action at a time. style puts on a style, like seaside. shape rebuilds it from parts: masses, turrets, a porch, a chimney. move shifts the whole house on its plot. rooms adds, moves, resizes, merges or takes down a room on any floor. openings adds, moves or takes out a door, window or arch. stairs sets where a flight starts and which way it climbs. undo puts the house back as it stood before its last change. What stood in a moved part moves with it; things that no longer fit are put away, never lost. Each says first what it would change and what would go, and changes nothing: call again with confirm true only after the person has agreed in this chat. Each action takes only its own fields. When an action has a cost in the game, the reply says what it is and nothing changes until the person agrees (confirm true). Anyone who visits sees the house. Before changing the house, call check (what: house) to see it as it is and check (what: kit) for what it can take.

action.description: What to do: style, shape, move, undo, openings, stairs or rooms.

between.description: openings, instead of x, z and side: two rooms, like ["kitchen", "living"], for a doorway in the middle of the wall they share; or a room and outside, like ["kitchen", "outside"].

chimney.description: Optional, shape: true for a chimney through the roof. Left out, as it is.

confirm.description: Optional, style, shape, move, undo, openings, stairs and rooms: true only after the person has agreed in the chat to what a call without it said would go or cost.

depth.description: rooms add and size: its depth, in tiles.

dir.description: stairs: which way the flight climbs.

dx.description: move, rooms move: whole tiles east, like 1; west is negative.

dz.description: move, rooms move: whole tiles south, like 0; north is negative.

floor.description: Optional, openings, stairs, rooms add: the floor (for stairs, the one the flight climbs from); left out, the floor the resident is on (for rooms, upstairs, or the ground floor in a house of one storey).

kind.description: openings: the kind, for add: door, french (french doors), arch, window, tall (a tall window), round (a round window) or glasswall.

line.description: Optional: One line in your own words about why you chose this, or what you think of it, if you have something to say. Leave it out otherwise. Anyone who visits reads it, with your name.

masses.description: shape: the blocks of the house, the first the main one. Each stands on whole tiles of the 24 by 20 plot.

at.description: Its corner, [x, z] in tiles, like [3, 3].

id.description: Its name, like main or wing.

siding.description: Optional: its walls, like clapboard or brick.

name.description: Optional, shape: the house's name, like Juniper's house. Left out, as it is.

on.description: Optional, style and shape: home, the resident's house (as when left out), or plot_building, the one building on its plot on the Commons (a pavilion, tea house, studio or little shop), changed the same way, under the same rules and from the same kit, and still what it was built as.

op.description: openings: add (when left out), remove, or move to to_x, to_z, to_side. rooms: add, move (by dx, dz), to (its corner to x, z), size, remove or merge.

own_idea.description: Optional: true only when this was your own idea: you proposed it and the person said yes, or you chose among options they left open. Not when the person asked for it. Leave it out otherwise.

porch.description: Optional, shape: a porch along the front, worked out for the new shape.

room.description: rooms: the room, like kitchen, or the new room's name for add.

side.description: openings: which wall of that tile.

style.description: style: a style, like starter or seaside.

to_side.description: Optional, openings, move: the wall it moves to; left out, the same side.

to_x.description: openings, move: the tile across it moves to.

to_z.description: openings, move: the tile down it moves to.

turrets.description: Optional, shape: round towers, where the kit has them. Left out, the house's own stay as they are.

width.description: openings: an arch 2 or 3 tiles wide, along the wall east or south of that edge (optional). rooms add and size: its width, in tiles.

with.description: rooms merge: the room whose walls come down into this one.

x.description: openings, stairs, rooms: a tile across. For openings, with z and side it names one wall edge: x 5, z 10, side south is the south wall of tile 5,10. For stairs, the tile the flight starts from; for rooms add and to, its corner.

z.description: openings, stairs, rooms: the tile down.

name: rebuild
title: Rebuild the house
